Help Alkhidmat Restore 2.2 million lives in Gaza

Following a ceasefire in Gaza after 25 months of severe humanitarian crisis, 2.2 million displaced and oppressed Palestinians now have a chance to move toward a new normal life amid destruction and rubble. However, from infrastructure to homes, schools, hospitals, clean water, and healthcare facilities, there is almost nothing left in Gaza to restart life. The entire Gazan population now looks to the world for support in rehabilitating Gaza and restoring life.

Alkhidmat Foundation has already mobilised a large scale relief and rehabilitation campaign in Gaza, providing over 7,302 tons of life saving aid including cooked meals, clean water, canned food, and hygiene kits. The organisation is now shifting focus to reconstruction, rebuilding residential towers, hospitals, schools, mosques, and clean water systems under its "Rebuild Gaza" initiative. Your support today can help transform today’s ruins into tomorrow’s hope
